description: Domaine Collotte's 2015 Bourgogne Rouge Cuvée de Noble Souche is a supple Pinot Noir with cherry fruit, light spice, and a gentle mineral accent. Fine tannins and a graceful frame make this a mature, understated red Burgundy.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2015 Domaine Collotte Bourgogne Rouge Cuvée de Noble Souche.
palate: Supple fruit, fine tannin, light earth
